rpo.volcanicDark.volcanicHearts.tooltip:
§aTrue§r: Enables the monochromatic volcanic health bar.§r

§cFalse§r: Disables the volcanic health bar for compatibility 
with other resource packs or just for user preference.
rpo.volcanicDark.volcanicHunger.tooltip:
§aTrue§r: Enables the monochromatic volcanic hunger bar.§r

§cFalse§r: Disables the volcanic hunger bar for compatibility 
with other resource packs or just for user preference.

§5§oThis option is compatible with AppleSkin.§r

§cFalse§r: Disables the volcanic armor bar for compatibility 
with other resource packs or just for user preference.
rpo.volcanicDark.volcanicBreath.tooltip:
§aTrue§r: Enables the monochromatic volcanic breath meter.§r

§cFalse§r: Disables the volcanic breath meter for compatibility

rpo.volcanicDark.volcanicExperience.tool:
§aTrue§r: Enables the monochromatic volcanic experience 
bar which includes the locator bar.§r

§cFalse§r: Disables the volcanic experience and locator bars 
for compatibility with other resource packs or just for 
user preference.
rpo.volcanicDark.volcanicHotbar.tooltip:
§aTrue§r: Enables the monochromatic volcanic hotbar.§r

§cFalse§r: Disables the volcanic hotbar for compatibility 
with other resource packs or just for user preference.
rpo.volcanicDark.volcanicCoreShaders.too:
§aTrue§r: Enables Volcanic Dark's Core Shaders which change 
things like the experience number and the grey labels in 
inventories.§r

§cFalse§r: Disables volcanic dark's core shaders for compatibility 
with other resource packs, user preference, or if they cause 
issues with pack loading.
rpo.volcanicDark.volcanicOutline: Add Outlines Around Hard to See Items
rpo.volcanicDark.volcanicOutline.tooltip:
§aTrue§r: Adds outlines around items that are hard to see 
in the inventory like obsidian, coal blocks, and black 
concrete.§r

§cFalse§r: Disables outlines around items.
